AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description: ArchiveTune is a music player. It can play a song, album or artist by name, pause, resume, skip to the next or previous track, and tell what is currently playing. Operational Patterns: - Call 'getNowPlaying' to know what is playing before answering questions about the current song. - Call 'playMusic' with the song title and, when known, the artist (for example 'Fuck You Dr. Dre'). Constraints: - 'playMusic' needs a non-empty query.
